candidates.sql: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, coalesce(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'paid' LEFT JOIN lines AS l ON l.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id
SELECT c.id AS customer_id FROM customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'paid')
SELECT o.customer_id, count(*) AS paid_order_count FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING count(*) >= 2

WITH ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY ordered_on DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid') SELECT customer_id, id AS order_id FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1

SELECT coalesce(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders AS o JOIN lines AS l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.ordered_on >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on < '2025-02-01'

SELECT c.id AS customer_id, coalesce(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_cents), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'paid' LEFT JOIN lines AS l ON l.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT l.sku FROM lines AS l JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = l.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid'

SELECT c.id AS customer_id FROM customers AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o JOIN lines AS l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'paid' AND l.sku = 'A') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o JOIN lines AS l ON l.order_id = o.id WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'paid' AND l.sku = 'B')
SELECT a.id AS agent_id, count(t.id) AS ticket_count FROM agents AS a LEFT JOIN tickets AS t ON t.agent_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id
SELECT a.id AS agent_id FROM agents AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets AS t WHERE t.agent_id = a.id AND t.resolved_on IS NULL)
SELECT ticket_id, count(*) AS reply_count FROM events WHERE kind = 'reply' GROUP BY ticket_id HAVING count(*) >= 2

WITH ranked AS (SELECT ticket_id, id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY happened_on ASC, id ASC) AS rn FROM events WHERE kind = 'reply') SELECT ticket_id, id AS event_id FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
SELECT id AS ticket_id FROM tickets WHERE opened_on >= '2025-01-01' AND opened_on < '2025-02-01' AND (resolved_on IS NULL OR resolved_on >= '2025-02-01')
SELECT id AS ticket_id, priority FROM tickets WHERE resolved_on IS NULL ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT DISTINCT a.team FROM agents AS a JOIN tickets AS t ON t.agent_id = a.id

SELECT a.id AS agent_id FROM agents AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets AS t WHERE t.agent_id = a.id AND t.priority >= 2) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets AS t WHERE t.agent_id = a.id AND t.priority = 0)
SELECT i.id AS invoice_id, i.total_cents - coalesce(sum(p.amount_cents), 0) AS outstanding_cents FROM invoices AS i LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON p.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY i.id

WITH balances AS (SELECT i.id, i.account_id, i.total_cents - coalesce(sum(p.amount_cents), 0) AS outstanding_cents FROM invoices AS i LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON p.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY i.id) SELECT account_id, sum(outstanding_cents) AS outstanding_cents FROM balances GROUP BY account_id HAVING sum(outstanding_cents) > 0
SELECT i.id AS invoice_id FROM invoices AS i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments AS p WHERE p.invoice_id = i.id)

WITH balances AS (SELECT i.id, i.account_id, i.total_cents - coalesce(sum(p.amount_cents), 0) AS outstanding_cents FROM invoices AS i LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON p.invoice_id = i.id GROUP BY i.id) SELECT a.id AS account_id FROM accounts AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM balances AS b WHERE b.account_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM balances AS b WHERE b.account_id = a.id AND b.outstanding_cents > 0)
SELECT substr(issued_on, 1, 7) AS month, sum(total_cents) AS billed_cents FROM invoices GROUP BY substr(issued_on, 1, 7) ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT invoice_id, id AS payment_id, sum(amount_cents) OVER (PARTITION BY invoice_id ORDER BY paid_on ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cents FROM payments ORDER BY invoice_id ASC, paid_on ASC, id ASC
SELECT a.plan, avg(i.total_cents) AS mean_cents FROM accounts AS a JOIN invoices AS i ON i.account_id = a.id GROUP BY a.plan
SELECT a.id AS account_id FROM accounts AS a WHERE a.active = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices AS i WHERE i.account_id = a.id AND i.issued_on >= '2025-01-01' AND i.issued_on < '2025-02-01')
